dialogues.title: New Neighbors
dialogues.description: Two neighbors meet for the first time.

lines.text: Здравствуйте! Меня зовут Иван, я ваш новый сосед.
lines.translation: Hello! My name is Ivan, I'm your new neighbor.
Nice to meet you! My name is Olga.
Where's the nearest store around here?

dialogues.title: At the Train Station
dialogues.description: A passenger buys a train ticket.

lines.translation: Hello! Where are you traveling to?

lines.text: Мне нужен билет до Москвы, пожалуйста.
lines.translation: I need a ticket to Moscow, please.

lines.text: Туда и обратно или только в одну сторону?
lines.translation: Round trip or one way only?

lines.text: Есть поезд в восемь часов. Подойдёт?
lines.translation: There's a train at eight o'clock. Does that work?

dialogues.title: A Business Meeting
dialogues.description: A director checks in on a project's progress.

lines.translation: Alexey, how is the new project progressing?

lines.text: В целом хорошо, но у нас небольшая задержка с поставщиками.
lines.translation: Overall well, but we have a small delay with the suppliers.
Will this seriously affect the deadlines?

lines.text: Не думаю, если мы ускорим следующий этап.
lines.translation: I don't think so, if we speed up the next stage.

lines.text: Конечно, я пришлю отчёт к пятнице.
lines.translation: Of course, I'll send the report by Friday.
